ms.promise:
・A document with list of relevant metrics along with their sources

ms.criteria:
・15 relevant metrics in the document along with their sources. (E.g. Quarterly Revenue in ADA and Quarterly Revenue in USD are two distinct metrics)
・Target 5 responses from the Cardano community. Document displays all outputs as described above
・Target 3 responses from the Wider crypto community. Document displays all outputs as described above
・Regarding metrics important to the non-crypto community, upon reflection there are no metrics that the non-crypto community is looking for as they are not concerned with crypto.
・The outline will display the structure of the report including a heading
ms.report:
Links to all the documentation: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UWZBykPykRr_qVrfkd6gWJ-eyEHbKmMs?usp=drive_link
After receiving feedback, I have:
・Made changes to the file names as suggested
・Addressed why we have overdelivered on our 15 metrics in the excel file

In terms of the quality of the feedback. I agree it is not the most substantial, but at the same time we cannot control the quality of the feedback we get. Everyone seemed okay with the metrics and we went ahead with them. I don't think it is fair to reject our proof of achievement due to circumstances we cannot control when we have clearly delivered on every tangible miletone we do have control over. On top of that we have over delivered in some areas which you have acknowledged yourselves.

(I have checked with the members whose emails are visible and they are fine with it for the purposes of this activity)
